evidence.notes: Dynamic SELECT-list construction executes with local bind variables.
Bind maps execute with scalar values and AccessLevel overload parsing.
Malformed dynamic SOQL raises catchable QueryException.

source.content: @isTest private class DataSoqlDynamicSelectorTest { @isTest static void exercisesDynamicSelectors() { insert new Account(Name = 'Acme', Rating = 'Hot'); insert new Account(Name = 'Beta', Rating = 'Warm'); String wanted = 'Acme'; String fields = 'Id, Name, Rating'; String queryText = 'SELECT ' + fields + ' FROM Account WHERE Name = :wanted ORDER BY Name'; List<Account> rows = Database.query(queryText); System.assertEquals(1, rows.size()); Map<String,Object> binds = new Map<String,Object>(); binds.put('rating', 'Warm'); rows = Database.queryWithBinds('SELECT Id, Name FROM Account WHERE Rating = :rating ORDER BY Name', binds, AccessLevel.USER_MODE); System.assertEquals(1, rows.size()); Boolean caught = false; try { Database.query('SELECT FROM Account'); } catch (QueryException qe) { caught = true; } System.assert(caught); } }
